item.title: Fruit Classification (K-Means Training) Interactive Platform
item.description:
In 2024, I served as a lecturer for the Artificial Intelligence elective course at Shanghai High School. To help students better understand the working principles of the K-Means model while teaching fundamental AI concepts, I developed a fruit classification system that visually demonstrates the operation of the K-Means model.

Get the manual by clicking here:https://pygargous.com/fruitClassificationWeb/
